description: Royal Air Maroc Safar Flyer Award Miles, Status Miles and Status Flights for Royal Air Maroc flights. Award Miles = distance x fare family % (fam: Eco Essential 50, Eco Classic 100, Family Classic 100, Eco Flex 150, Biz Classic 150, Biz Flex 200), rounded down per flight; Status Miles are the same. The Silver, Gold and Platinum bonus (50%, 75%, 100%) adds Award Miles only. Royal Air Maroc publishes no minimum for short flights, so none is applied, and no fare-family weighting for Status Flights, so each flight counts as one. Set noearn to Y for an award, Cash and Miles or E-class-without-luggage ticket (earns nothing). Progress toward Silver (20,000 Status Miles or 15 Status Flights), Gold (35,000 or 30) and Platinum (75,000 or 75) in a calendar year; qm and qf are the totals so far. Give segs: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and the ISO country codes of its two airports. Takes no price. Uses cwsi.net's calculator and the airline's published rules. Unofficial.

creditClass.description: The booking class letter on the ticket, for creditTo (required with creditTo). Ignored without creditTo.

creditFlights.description: The flights for creditTo: one entry per one-way flight, in order, with its great-circle miles (calculate_flight_distance gives them) and optionally from/to airport codes. Defaults to segs when they carry miles.

from.description: The departure airport's code; labels the breakdown.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's code; labels the breakdown.

creditStatus.description: Your status in the creditTo program, by its name as listed under creditTo. Defaults to the base level. Ignored without creditTo.

creditTo.description: Credit the flights to a partner program instead of Royal Air Maroc's own: american = American AAdvantage (creditStatus one of: AAdvantage member, AAdvantage Gold, AAdvantage Platinum, AAdvantage Platinum Pro, AAdvantage Executive Platinum); alaska = Atmos Rewards (creditStatus one of: Atmos Rewards member, Atmos Silver, Atmos Gold, Atmos Platinum, Atmos Titanium); ba-club = British Airways Club (creditStatus one of: Blue, Bronze, Silver, Gold). Earns by each flight's distance and the booking class at the program's published partner rates; leave creditTo out for the airline's own program. Give the booking class letter as creditClass. The flights are segs (their miles), or creditFlights.

fam.description: Fare family. EE = Eco Essential (Economy, 50%); EC = Eco Classic (Economy, 100%); FC = Family Classic (Economy, 100%); EF = Eco Flex (Economy, 150%); BC = Biz Classic (Business, 150%); BF = Biz Flex (Business, 200%). The fare family on your Royal Air Maroc ticket. Eco Essential earns half the distance; Biz Flex earns double.

noearn.description: Is it an award ticket, a Cash and Miles ticket or an E class booking without luggage?. N = No; Y = Yes (earns nothing). Royal Air Maroc says these earn no Miles. Choose No if you do not know.

qf.description: Status Flights you have this calendar year (optional). Each flight flown counts as one.

qm.description: Status Miles you have this calendar year (optional). Used only for the progress toward the next Safar Flyer status.

segs.description: The flights, one way and in order, one entry per flight (1 to 8): fromCountry and toCountry, the ISO 3166 two-letter country codes of its two airports; miles, its great-circle distance in miles (1 to 12,500); optional from and to, the IATA codes of its two airports, which label the breakdown; some airlines also use them (Vladivostok, VVO, on JAL and ANA; the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle, MAD-BCN, on Iberia; the long-haul tables named by city on SAS).

from.description: The departure airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

fromCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the departure airport, e.g. DE.

miles.description: Great-circle distance of this flight in miles.

to.description: The arrival airport's IATA code, e.g. SYD. Labels the breakdown; JAL and ANA use it to spot Vladivostok (VVO), Qantas to pick its route tables, Iberia to spot the Madrid-Barcelona Air Shuttle (MAD, BCN), and SAS to pick its long-haul tables (named by city).

toCountry.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code of the arrival airport, e.g. DE.

status.description: Your Safar Flyer status. BL = Blue or not yet a member; SI = Silver (+50%); GO = Gold (+75%); PL = Platinum (+100%). The Silver, Gold and Platinum bonus is paid on Award Miles for Royal Air Maroc flights; it does not count toward status.

trip.description: Trip. ow = One way; rt = Round trip. Round trip counts the same flights back the other way.
